import random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m','/workspace/submission/main.py')
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
tmpl=(b'\xaa'*8).hex(); kinds='KKKDZQTK'
def gen(rng,nf,nn,capset,plen,vset,prob_off=0.0):
    nodes=['v%02d'%i for i in range(nn)]
    caps=dict((n,rng.choice(capset)) for n in nodes)
    flows=[];offers={}
    for i in range(nf):
        k=rng.randint(plen[0],min(plen[1],nn))
        path=rng.sample(nodes,k)
        fid='f%02d'%i
        flows.append(dict(id=fid,path=path,template=tmpl,kinds=kinds))
        h=bytearray(b'\xaa'*8); h[3]=rng.randint(0,255); h[5]=rng.randint(0,7); h[6]=k+rng.randint(0,1)
        offers[fid]=[dict(header=bytes(h).hex(),count=rng.choice(vset))]
    ids=[f['id'] for f in flows]
    pin=rng.sample(ids,rng.randint(0,2)) if rng.random()<0.3 else []
    return dict(mode='plan',capacities=caps,flows=flows,warmup=rng.choice([0,1]),pinned=pin,offers=offers)
rng=random.Random(40000)
worst=(0,None)
t0=time.time()
for t in range(20000):
    nf=rng.choice([18,20,22]); nn=rng.choice([2,3,4,5,8,14])
    capset=rng.choice([[1,1],[2,2],[1,2,3],[3],[4],[2],[1],[1,2],[3,4]])
    plen=rng.choice([(2,2),(2,3),(2,4),(3,4),(2,6)])
    if nn<plen[1] and nn<3: continue
    vset=rng.choice([[1],[2],[1,2],[1,2,3],[5,10],[1,2,4,8],[3,6,9],[1,3,7]])
    req=gen(rng,nf,nn,capset,plen,vset)
    st=time.time(); got=m.respond(req); el=time.time()-st
    if el>worst[0]: worst=(el,t)
    if el>1.0:
        print('SLOW %.2f'%el, t, nf, nn, capset, plen, vset); break
print('worst %.3fs at %s, total %.1fs'%(worst[0],worst[1],time.time()-t0))
PYEOF
